annotations.title: Link to add files to a fax

description: An address where the person adds their pages to their XipFax draft from their own browser, PDFs or photos, with no sign-in there: for a file you can’t reach or pass to add_fax_file, such as one on their phone or one attached to this chat. Give the address to the person alone, since whoever holds it can add pages to their draft. It works once, for 30 minutes. Ask them to add their pages there, press “Done adding pages”, and tell you when they’re done; then call finish_fax_file_link with its link_id.
name: add_fax_file_link

expires_at.description: When the address stops working, in UTC.

link_id.description: The link, as finish_fax_file_link takes it.

url.description: The address to give the person, who opens it in their browser: it needs no sign-in, and works once, for 30 minutes.

title: Link to add files to a fax
